## Task

Make `SpeakerSegment` timestamps optional and add a pure parser that turns a plain-text interview transcript into `SpeakerSegment[]`, so text transcripts can be analysed without audio (ADR 0002).

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADRs 0001-0003): transcript upload replaces audio/video transcription

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `startTime` / `endTime` are optional on `SpeakerSegment` and `Evidence` in `src/domain/types.ts`.
- [ ] The worker (`buildFallbackJobCards`, `matchQuoteToSegment`) and the store's manual evidence entries no longer invent `0` timestamps; they pass timestamps through only when the segment has them.
- [ ] `JobCardEvidencePanel` hides the timestamp when an evidence item has none.
- [ ] New pure module `src/domain/transcript/parsePlainTextTranscript.ts` (no Vue, Pinia or DOM imports) returns `SpeakerSegment[]`:
  - a line `Name: text` starts a new segment with `speakerId` `Name`;
  - a non-empty line without a speaker prefix continues the previous segment;
  - text before the first speaker prefix gets the speaker `Unknown`;
  - blank lines are ignored, whitespace is trimmed, and Windows (`\r\n`) line endings work;
  - empty or whitespace-only input returns `[]`.
- [ ] Co-located `parsePlainTextTranscript.spec.ts` covers each rule above.
- [ ] `npm run code-quality` passes for the touched files (pre-existing `vue-tsc -b` errors are tracked separately).

## Out of scope

- Upload UI (`FileDropzone` rework is a separate task-list item).
- Parsing inline timestamps (e.g. `[00:12:30]`) or other formats such as `.vtt` / `.srt`.
- Linking evidence to segments by ID.
